notes: The manual says 'potentiometer or other analog sensor'; the circuit image shows a potentiometer, so that is used.

Potentiometer straddles the breadboard centre gap: outer legs in columns 11 and 13 (row e, bank t), wiper in column 12 (row f, bank b). Column letters follow the catalogue's naming of the image's two halves.
Black wire goes to the second GND header pin on the power header (GND.2); the image shows it at the lower of the two GND pins.
Red wire (5V) ends on column 13 and black (GND) on column 11, both row d; yellow (A0) ends on column 12 row g, in the same strip as the wiper.
Pot outer legs are interchangeable (GND=VCC symmetric); assigned column 11 to GND and column 13 to VCC following the wire colours.
A USB cable to the computer is implied by the serial communication but not drawn, so it is omitted.
